planned_scope: Fresh two-request session, target15 player turns. Every first draft and first revision retained.
player_policy: Separate player driver: patient, observant newcomer willing to engage with other peoples interests. Allows quiet and follows invitations when interested, without a predetermined companion or plot.
driver_exposure: Driver reads published fiction and generic editorial requests for relay, not drafts, full Covenant, story prompts or reviews. Root sees drafts. Not a strictly blinded trial.
